timeline.heading: Building cbeens.dev
timeline.body: After several years working in the software industry, for both startups and large enterprises, I decided to take the leap and start my own company. I spent months building the cbeens.dev brand, digital infrastructure, and website framework; officially launching in April 2026.

timeline.heading: Continuing to Build
timeline.body: I continue to build and improve the cbeens.dev platform, proving that high-end software doesn't have to be out of reach for small businesses or solopreneurs.
